arxiv-2411-13865.title: Breaking Information Cocoons: A Hyperbolic Framework for Balancing Exploration and Exploitation in Recommender Systems
arxiv-2411-13865.creator: Qiyao Ma, Menglin Yang, Mingxuan Ju, Tong Zhao, Neil Shah, Rex Ying
arxiv-2411-13865.description: Abstract . Modern recommender systems often create information cocoons, restricting users’ exposure to diverse content. Ideally, this balance can be captured with a hierarchical representation, where depth search facilitates exploitation and breadth search enables exploration.
